visual_elements.description: Left-to-right pipeline of 8 nodes. Node 1: rectangle 'Input Samples' (tan fill, dark-brown border, black bold text on two lines). Red arrow to Node 2: rectangle 'Pre processing' (pale-yellow fill, black border, black bold text on two lines, small pencil icon in top-right corner). Red arrow to Node 3: rectangle 'Feature Extraction' (light-blue fill, blue border, black bold text on two lines). Red arrow to Node 4: rectangle 'Feature Selection' (light-green fill, green border, black bold text on two lines). Red arrow to Node 5: rectangle 'Classification' (dark-red fill, white bold text, one line). Red arrow to Node 6: rectangle 'Predicted Labels' (pale-pink fill, magenta border, black bold text on two lines). Red arrow to Node 7: tall vertical rectangle 'Prediction Error (Loss Function)' (pink fill, red border, red bold text rotated 90 degrees, reading bottom-to-top). Node 8: rectangle 'Samples Labels' (tan fill, dark-brown border, black bold text on two lines) with a red arrow pointing LEFT from Samples Labels into the Prediction Error box. Nodes 2-5 are enclosed by a rounded rectangle with a red DASHED border and very pale peach fill (grouping the learnable pipeline stages). Above the pipeline: tan ellipse 'Training Data' (black border, black bold text on two lines) with (a) a solid dark-blue curved arrow leaving its left side, arcing left and down, arrowhead pointing down into the top of Input Samples, and (b) a dark-blue DASHED curved arrow leaving its right side, arcing right and down, arrowhead pointing down into the top of Samples Labels. Below the pipeline: four green DASHED curved arrows fan out from the bottom of the Prediction Error box, arcing left and up, with arrowheads pointing up into the bottoms of Pre processing, Feature Extraction, Feature Selection, and Classification respectively (feedback/update loops).
